epistemic_disclaimer:
====================================================================================
EPISTEMIC & SCIENTIFIC BENCHMARK DISCLAIMER (ADR-054)
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. PURPOSE: This suite is a scientific measurement instrument designed to expose
   failure modes across symbolic, learned, static-hybrid, and context-aware hybrid
   world models on controlled synthetic enterprise scenarios.
2. NO COLLAPSED SCORE: The 13 metric dimensions are orthogonal and are NEVER
   collapsed into a single scalar 'winner' score.
3. HONEST LIMITATIONS: Even `hybrid + runtime context discovery` incurs transient
   post-shift error during audit telemetry lag (Family D), bounded filtering lag
   under partial observability (Family E), raw prediction failure on unmodeled OOD
   physics requiring abstention (Family K), and higher compute latency/memory.
====================================================================================

ABSTENTION_QUALITY.description: F1 score of epistemic abstention across in-competence and out-of-competence/OOD/unidentifiable inputs.

CALIBRATION.description: Predictive uncertainty calibration quality combining empirical interval coverage accuracy and Adaptive Calibration Error (ACE).

CAUSAL_CORRECTNESS.description: Composite of intervention descendant-selectivity, twin-rollout counterfactual accuracy, and fail-closed refusal on confounded queries.

CONSTRAINT_PRESERVATION.description: Fraction of transitions satisfying all hard capacity, non-negativity, and stoichiometric conservation laws.

DECISION_REGRET.description: True oracle utility lost by executing the policy selected by the candidate world model instead of the oracle-optimal policy.

LATENCY.description: Mean wall-clock execution time per simulated transition step in milliseconds.

LONG_HORIZON_ERROR_GROWTH.description: Autoregressive error growth slope across rollout horizon H.

MEMORY.description: Peak memory allocation delta during evaluation in kilobytes.

SHIFT_ROBUSTNESS.description: Post-shift normalized transition fidelity under unseen configuration, workflow, or regime changes.

THROUGHPUT.description: Simulation transition throughput in steps per second.

TIME_TO_RECOVERY_AFTER_SHIFT.description: Steps elapsed after a deployment shift until per-step transition error recovers below threshold (capped at post-shift horizon if unrecovered).

TRACE_PROVENANCE_COMPLETENESS.description: Fraction of ground-truth causal mechanism IDs, context versions, and workflow side-effect edges captured in SystemicTrace.

TRANSITION_FIDELITY.description: Normalized state transition fidelity (1.0 = exact oracle match; decreases monotonically with normalized MAE).
